# Backend (generated by b-dash)

## Run

```powershell
python -m venv .venv
.\.venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1
pip install -e ".[dev]"
cp .env.example .env
uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
```

## Test

```powershell
pytest
pytest --cov=app
```

## Layout

- `app/main.py` — FastAPI entry, generated by b-dash. Lists every enabled module's router.
- `app/<module>/...` — per-module backend code (router, service, model, etc.)
- `app/config.py`, `app/database.py`, `app/errors.py`, `app/middleware/error_handler.py` — base scaffold (do not edit)

## Customize

Drop replacements under `../overrides/<same-path>/` to preserve them across regenerations.
